changelog: TIER A3 #A3-3 closure (fire-17 P1A-META-E3): §sec:loophole 'All 7 forms were rejected' language replaced with 'All 7 forms were assessed at the theoretical level only'. Now explicitly distinguishes the theoretical-structure conclusion (ECH adds nothing beyond ΛCDM+w0wa for the 7 disguised forms) from a quantitative posterior-preference rejection (which would require the converged Paper~I(b) Table IV DESI DR2 w0wa chain). The chain hosting the quantitative test has accumulated ~3.8e4 samples with R̂-1 ≈ 3e-2 (per Paper I(b) Table III ‡ footnote) — descending toward publication-quality target R̂-1 < 1e-2 but not yet there. Theoretical-structure conclusion stands; quantitative rejection gated on chain convergence. Closes fire-17 P1A-META-E3 logical inconsistency between 'all rejected' + 'never implemented computationally'. PDF 23pp/1.17MB/md5 d742d3f4.

TIER A3 #A3-6 closure (fire-17 P1B-META-E3): 3.9σ inverse-variance combination direction-of-bias clarified. Original text said 'neglects shared calibration systematics; the published joint analysis at 3.6σ is the headline' — but didn't state which direction the neglect biases. Correct direction: shared systematics produce positively correlated errors → underestimate the combined σ → OVERESTIMATE the significance. So 3.9σ is an upper bound on the true significance, not a lower bound. New text makes this explicit + identifies the Tau-A self-calibration as the dominant systematic the published joint analysis accounts for. PDF 11pp/851KB/md5 ea7b3405.
